title: Ashbury Rewards Training Note: Award-Activity Discount on Points Purchases
content:
Ashbury Rewards members who redeem points for award nights often pay less per thousand points when they buy points.

**What is the award-activity discount?**
The award-activity discount is seventy-five cents per thousand points when at least three award redemption transactions were posted in the twelve months before the handling date, twenty-five cents when one or two were posted, and nothing when none was posted. It reduces the price per thousand points of a points purchase.

**Which transactions count?**
Award redemption transactions — the points deducted for Reward Night Rate reservations — posted on the account in the twelve months before the handling date, which are the transactions posted after the same day number twelve months earlier, up to and including the handling date. Certificate top-offs are not award redemption transactions.

**What are the bands?**

| Award redemption transactions in the twelve months | Discount per 1000 points |
|---|---|
| 3 or more | 0.75 USD |
| 1 or 2 | 0.25 USD |
| None | None |

**What does it do to a price? (hypothetical figures)**
A price of 12.00 US dollars per thousand points with 3 award redemptions in the window becomes 11.25 US dollars per thousand; with 2, it becomes 11.75.
